ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
BAHAUDDIN ZAKARIYA UNIVERSITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Bahauddin Zakariya University Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 25th June, 1983]
No. Legis : 3 (11)/83.-The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information :--
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Babauddin Zakariya
University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have been taken effect from the 1st July, 1982.

Amendment it section 5 of the Act No. III of 1975

ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
ORDINANCE XI OF 1983
BAHAUDDIN ZAKARIYA UNIVERSITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Bahauddin Zakariya University Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 25th June, 1983]
No. Legis : 3 (11)/83.-The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for
general information :--
2. Amendment it section 5 of
the Act No. III of 1975.--In the Babauddin Zakariya University Act, 1975,
in section 5, in subsection (1) for the words "Multan Division", the
words "Multan and D. G. Khan Divisions and, till such time as may be
notified by Government, the Okara District of Lahore Division" shall be
substituted.
